failure_mode_catalog.title: Ingestion Schema Mismatch
failure_mode_catalog.description: JSONL ingestion fails because schema of incoming data doesn't match expected schema
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: New data source added with incompatible format
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Ingestion pipeline stops; no new data flows
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: Schema validation error on first record

failure_mode_catalog.title: Schema Drift in Mermaid Diagrams
failure_mode_catalog.description: Mermaid diagrams diverge from actual system architecture; agents rely on stale diagrams for decisions
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: Architecture changes not reflected in diagrams
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Agent decisions based on incorrect understanding of system
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: Automated diagram drift check (not currently implemented)

failure_mode_catalog.title: Missing Relationship Edges
failure_mode_catalog.description: Implicit dependencies not declared; system assumes relationships that don't exist
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: New subsystem added without dependency graph registration
failure_mode_catalog.impact: System operates with incomplete model; cascading failures possible

failure_mode_catalog.title: Circular Dependency Deadlock
failure_mode_catalog.description: Agent A waits for Agent B; Agent B waits for Agent A; system deadlock
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: Agent handoff protocol creates circular waits
failure_mode_catalog.impact: System completely stuck; requires manual intervention
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: Watchdog timer; circular dependency graph analysis

failure_mode_catalog.title: Session Checkpoint Recovery Failure
failure_mode_catalog.description: Session checkpoint exists but cannot be resumed; execution lost
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: Checkpoint written but resume path not implemented for that cycle type
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Work lost; agent execution cannot resume; manually redone
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: Recovery attempt fails; fallback to manual intervention

failure_mode_catalog.title: Memory System Exhaustion
failure_mode_catalog.description: STM or LTM grows unbounded; system runs out of memory
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: No automatic eviction policy; manual cleanup not run
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Agent execution slows; memory errors; system crash

failure_mode_catalog.title: RBAC Policy Conflict
failure_mode_catalog.description: Agent has conflicting permissions; authorization decision undefined
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Agent cannot execute safely; operations blocked
mitigation: Policy conflict detection in RBAC engine

failure_mode_catalog.title: Tool Contract Breakage
failure_mode_catalog.description: Agent calls tool with wrong parameters; tool returns unexpected format
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: Tool interface changes but agent code not updated
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Agent execution fails; error handling may not catch edge case

failure_mode_catalog.title: Workflow State Inconsistency
failure_mode_catalog.description: GitHub Actions workflow state in GitHub API doesn't match local state in .codex/
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: GitHub API lag; local state stale
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Decisions based on stale state; workflow coordination errors

failure_mode_catalog.title: CI Enforcement Gap
failure_mode_catalog.description: Breaking change merged without triggering CI check
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: CI gate misconfigured or bypass used

failure_mode_catalog.title: Entity Normalization Failure
failure_mode_catalog.description: Same entity (agent/workflow/deliverable) has multiple IDs; deduplication fails

failure_mode_catalog.title: Knowledge Graph Incoherence
failure_mode_catalog.description: Learned patterns in LTM contradict current system state
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: Patterns not updated when system changes
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Agent decisions suboptimal; may not be harmful
mitigation: Automatic pattern invalidation on system change

failure_mode_catalog.title: Multi-Agent Handoff Failure
failure_mode_catalog.description: Agent A hands off to Agent B; context not properly passed; B cannot execute
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Task execution chain broken; work lost
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: Handoff timeout; agent reports missing context

failure_mode_catalog.title: Observability Data Loss
failure_mode_catalog.description: Telemetry not persisted; telemetry database corrupted or lost
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: SQLite transaction failure; database not backed up
failure_mode_catalog.impact: No observability; cannot debug system issues
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: Database integrity check; transaction rollback detection

failure_mode_catalog.title: Deferral Language Bypass
failure_mode_catalog.description: Agent uses deferral language in commit messages; governance check doesn't catch it
failure_mode_catalog.trigger: Deferral language in commit message; workflow only checks PR body
failure_mode_catalog.impact: Policy violation not caught; audit trail incomplete
failure_mode_catalog.detection_method: GitHub push hook scanning commits (not implemented)

recommendations.method: Schema version field + validation at ingestion
